The *Apuññapañha* ("Unconscious Wrong-Doing", Mil 5.2.6) is a discourse unit within the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. The text concerns doctrinal and ethical dilemmas discussed between King Milinda and the venerable Nāgasena, with SuttaCentral noting thematic or textual connections to the Vinaya's first *Pārājika* rule (*Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pārājika* 1) as well as an earlier Milindapañha dialogue, the *Jānantājānantapāpakaraṇapañha* (Mil 3.7.8) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records three modern translations of the text in three languages [SuttaCentral].

No direct external canonical parallels are listed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
